author: claude
summary: Fixed three visual bugs in the Activity page's CPU/RAM/VRAM pressure sparklines (no baseline-anchored fill, no threshold reference line, no intensity-based coloring), then added a below-graph horizontal meter bar per row showing the current value with a smoothed width transition between polls.

files.change: Added buildSparklineAreaPath() (baseline-anchored fill path, closes at SPARK_HEIGHT), a scaleY() helper factored out of the existing point-scaling math, and pressureTier() (3-tier: normal <70 / elevated >=70 current-value / hot sustained>=90 for 2 samples, reusing existing isSustainedHighPressure). ResourceRow now renders a dashed threshold reference line at the 90% mark, a semi-transparent tier-colored area fill under the line, and colors the polyline/dot/value text by tier instead of only swapping the trailing dot between two colors. Follow-up in the same file: each row now also renders a `system-resource-strip__meter-row` below the sparkline -- a thin horizontal bar (`system-resource-strip__meter`) whose fill width tracks the current pct and whose CSS `transition: width` (in activity.css) animates smoothly between the ~2s polling ticks instead of snapping.

Fixed .system-resource-strip__spark height (20px -> 18px) to match the component's SPARK_HEIGHT/viewBox constant of 18 -- the mismatch was the root cause of the sparkline appearing vertically off from its intended baseline. Follow-up: added .system-resource-strip__meter-row/__meter/__meter-fill/__label-spacer/__value-spacer rules for the new below-graph meter bar, including the width/background-color transition.

tests_updated: frontend/tests/unit/pages/Activity/SystemResourceStrip.test.tsx -- updated hot-tier color assertion (var(--warning-text-strong) -> var(--error)); added a case for the new elevated tier (>=70, not sustained) and a case confirming no tier color below 70; added meter-bar coverage (renders per row filled to current value, updates width on re-render as the trailing sample changes, and is empty while loading).
